findings.title: Trusted internal employee reconciliation failure is misclassified as ordinary input refusal
findings.owner: GOAL-CRFI-01 / Core GameCore runtime producer and CoreApplication classifier (TD02)
requirements: PER-CRFI-02-REVIEWED-003 first cause and no retry
GOAL-CRFI-01 trusted runtime internal failures versus ordinary input
findings.proof: CLASSIFIER_PROBE.json and classifier_probe.log: real reconciliation failure through public application twice; no battle_fault either time.
findings.impact: Fault gates, bounded cause query and observer terminal cleanup depend on a capsule that is never created for this failure. Same battle executes the next advance again. Actual corruption reached only via test setup is not asserted user reachable.
findings.correction: Distinguish trusted internal failure at actual producer/operation boundary using typed origin; preserve ordinary UnitNotFound/InvalidAction refusal and prepublication/private candidate semantics. Review related overloaded producer cases, including reconcile corroded nonemployee InvalidAction. Do not globally classify all UnitNotFound/InvalidAction errors terminal.
required_verification: Durable actual reconcile-failure public application regression with fixed first cause, unchanged last root and second-call battle_faulted.
Normal nonexistent-unit and invalid-action controls remain nonterminal; read-only/admin-profile/postcommit and unpublished/private retry stay valid.
Re-evaluate operation/producer classification enumeration, actor/observer/writer dependence, affected V01–04/V10–12 and existing feature/public seams on corrected source.
Refresh target, affected receipts and source/log/input identities; independent successor audit completes all 12 acceptances/12 validations/10 dimensions/100 inherited conditions/31 R06 maps.
